issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for DSTU2 to add optional ContactPoint phone-number part extensions for country code, area/zone/city code, local number, and private-network extension, with guidance that ContactPoint.value SHOULD still be populated.

The FHIR Extension Pack now owns active StructureDefinitions for contactpoint-country, contactpoint-area, contactpoint-local, and contactpoint-extension, and FHIR-41562 later changed their contexts to ContactPoint.value.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The current core checkout has no active extension definitions to correct, while the Extension Pack contains the requested current artifacts.
